eventDetail.scope: The 2026 International Conference on Electrical and Electronics Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (3EAl 2026) is a global academic forum dedicated to advancing foundational theories and emerging innovations in electrical engineering, electronic systems, and artificial intelligence. With a strong emphasis on academic rigor and technological progress, the conference aims to build a high-evel platform for international knowledge exchange and cross-disciplinary collaboration. Gathering leading scholars, researchers, and industry experts worldwide, the conference will explore cutting-edge developments, opportunities, and challenges across intelligent electrical systems, advanced electronic technologies, and Al-driven engineering applications. By fostering dialogue among diverse research communities, 3EAl 2026 seeks to accelerate scientific breakthroughs, promote impactful applications, and support the evolution of intelligent and sustainable engineering technologies.
